attackers_goals: A malicious user may attempt to access a domain controller to access and control Active Directory.
description: A user account has successfully logged on to a Domain Controller (DC), generating a Windows Event Log. This may be a sign of DC and Active Directory (AD) compromise.
investigative_actions: Ensure that the user is not a Domain Admin account. By default, Administrator groups have permission to access the domain controller. Check if the user is a service account that accesses a domain controller as part of its normal behavior. Verify that the user is not authenticating to group policy.
name: Abnormal User Login to Domain Controller
